{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Calculate response rate per site
response_rates = trial_df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(3)

# Find the site with the highest response rate
highest_site = response_rates.idxmax()
highest_rate = response_rates.max()

# Print results
print(f'Response rates by site: \n{response_rates}')
print(f'\nSite with highest response rate: {highest_site} ({highest_rate})')"}
